title: How Much Blood Does Your Heart Pump in One Day?
description:
Is it enough to fill a bathtub, a tanker, or a swimming pool?

About 2,000 US gallons, roughly 7,500 litres, per day for an average heart.

The number comes from cardiac output accumulated across tens of thousands of beats; it varies with body size and activity.

Over a 70-year lifetime, the heart can beat more than 2.5 billion times.
